one_line: Hold each product to the lens, then cut to it in use within two seconds; end with a comment-for-link ask.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 a woman at home squeezes colourful squishy blocks and a bead pouch up at the lens, half her face behind them. Said and subtitled from 0:00: "בזכות הג'לי בלוקס", then "הכרתי מותג ואני", "באמת לא מבינה".
q1_hook.why: A voice, a face and moving, colourful objects from frame one (H4, E1), with the line subtitled at once (H6). A personal discovery line (what brand is this?) opens a small gap the review answers (H5). The product is in her hands before any intro (S1).

beats.what: She squeezes jelly blocks and a bead pouch at the lens; the discovery line
beats.why: A personal claim with tactile pictures

beats.what: She holds up the finger-painting book and ink pad; "סקירה קטנה של המותג חושים"
beats.why: Names the brand and previews a later product

beats.what: Poolside close-ups: children's hands press and stack the jelly blocks
beats.why: Use follows the claim within 2 s

beats.what: She pulls scarves and animal cards out of a fabric tissue-box set
beats.why: A second product opens, back to her face

beats.what: A boy about 4 on a deck plays with the cards, then runs with knotted scarves as wings
beats.why: A play idea inside a small story

beats.what: She fans the finger-painting book: "ומוצר נוסף שאני רוצה להראות לכם"
A child's finger presses the ink pad and makes fingerprint animals in the book
Top-down: a pen adds details to fingerprint ladybugs; the ask is subtitled
beats.why: A pretty result under the ask

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Said and subtitled 0:50 to 0:52, and in the caption: comment on the video to get a link and coupon. The caption promises more episodes ("חכו גם לפרקים הבאים"). No specific question.
q2_flow.why: Each product repeats one pattern: she introduces it to the lens, then a child uses it within 2 s, so the middle keeps resetting (R3, E2). The intros at 0:19 and 0:33 act as mid re-hooks. Three products in 53 s leave each about 12 s (R2, R1). It ends right after the last demo (E8).

q3_cta.what: Said and subtitled 0:46 to 0:52: "לכו לחפש את המותג חושים בחנויות הצעצועים או שאם בא לכם קישור וקופון תגיבו לסרטון ואשלח לכם". Caption: "תגיבו לסרטון ואקפיץ לכם קישור". No comment word.
q3_cta.why: Said, shown and repeated in the caption after all three products, with something real to get, a link and coupon (C6, C2, C3). It offers two paths, stores or comment, and no keyword (C1, C3). The subtitle sits in the lower band over the footage (T4).

q4_shown.what: Three products, each held to the lens, then used by children: jelly blocks at a pool (0:07), a fabric set with scarves as wings (0:24), a finger-painting book making fingerprint animals (0:37). Brand name on the packs. No price, no code.
q4_shown.why: Each claim is followed within about 2 s by a child using the product, and she says she takes the blocks to the pool, which is first-hand (S6, F8). The brand name returns on packs and in speech without a logo card (H3). Children's faces and hands are on camera (S5).

q5_edit.what: About 29 shots in 53 s (first pass), about 1.8 s each; hard cuts between her to-camera shots and b-roll. No speed changes seen. Subtitles in 1 to 2 line chunks follow the voice. Ends on a top-down drawing shot with the ask.
q5_edit.why: A cut about every 2 s, with b-roll right after each claim, is brisk and follows the voice (E2, R3). Subtitles sync to speech throughout (E4, T1) but sit low over the b-roll (T2, T4). The last 4 s hold one drawing shot while the ask runs (E8).

q6_topic.what: A review of three sensory toys from one brand, told as a mother's discovery; it serves parents looking for sensory and open-ended play ideas.
q6_topic.why: A parent sharing a find reads like a friend's tip (K6), and practical play ideas sit inside small stories such as the scarf wings (K4, K2). It is a list of three with no single emotional peak (K1).

q7_filmed.what: Her to a handheld phone at home, close, eye level, soft daylight, products held to the lens. B-roll: top-down and handheld close-ups at a pool and on a wooden deck in daylight; a boy about 4 in medium shots; top-down hands on the book.
q7_filmed.why: Close direct address with products held to the lens feels like a friend (F6, F4, H8), and top-down hands on the book are clear (F5). Some handheld pool shots shake and show the blocks small (F7, F4).

q8_text.on_screen: White bold subtitles, 1 to 2 lines, about 70% down the frame, phrase by phrase with the voice: 0:00 "בזכות הג'לי בלוקס", 0:05 "היום אני אראה לכם סקירה קטנה", 0:20 "סיפורי בדים של חושים", 0:33 "ומוצר נוסף שאני רוצה להראות לכם", 0:51 "תגיבו לסרטון ואשלח לכם". No headline card, price or code.
q8_text.caption: "ממש ממש לא מבינה איך לא הכרתי את המותג חושים קודם!". About 35 words in 4 short lines: a promise of more products, a comment ask for a link, "בשיתוף @palphot" as the last line. No hashtags.
q8_text.why: Subtitles make it work muted (T1, E4) and sit just inside the lower band over the b-roll (T4, T2). The caption's first line repeats the hook (T7), and the partnership is named in words but on the last line, easy to miss (T8, S7).

weak_points: Three products in 53 s leave each thin; no price or code shown; children's faces and hands on camera; subtitles low over the product; the collaboration named only on the caption's last line; her face half hidden at 0:00.
lumebook_takeaway: Hold each book to the lens with one sentence, then cut to hands turning its pages within two seconds; end with one comment-for-link ask.
not_verified: Whether the link or coupon is personal and the coupon value; music (not established); who filmed the pool and deck footage; the machine transcript mishears some words, so subtitles are quoted. Cut count from the first pass.
